messages:
Jordan (Support): AcmeHealth reporting intermittent corrupted JSON from structured_output mode. They see extra fields from previous requests and sometimes two JSON objects concatenated.

Jordan (Support): Example response we got:
```json
{"patient":{"id":123,"name":"Alice"}}{"patient":{"id":124,"name":"Bob"}}
```

Priya (eng-runtime): Thanks. Do we have the request payload + headers + tenant id? Also which model & batching settings?

Jordan (Support): Sent sample: model=redwood-chat-3b, streaming=false, structured_output=true, batch_policy=continuous, kv_cache=enabled, session_id=acme-2026-03-12, concurrency=8. Using hosted API.

Tom (eng-ml): Sounds like KV cache namespace reuse + batching race. If batcher merges inputs, and we accidentally reuse a KV handle, outputs can append. There's an old bug where kv_clone wasn't used for non-streaming reqs.

Lina (oncall): I pulled logs for session acme-2026-03-12. I see overlapping request_ids: rq_gg3a reused kv_handle kv_77 across worker pool around 2026-03-12T16:22:11Z. Attaching small excerpt.

Jordan (Support): Excerpt:
```log
[16:22:11.112] rq=rq_gg3a start session=acme-2026-03-12 kv=kv_77
[16:22:11.118] rq=rq_xj9b start session=acme-2026-03-12 kv=kv_77
[16:22:11.226] rq=rq_gg3a complete out=...{"patient":{...}}
[16:22:11.230] rq=rq_xj9b complete out=...{"patient":{...}} <-- mixed
```

Priya (eng-runtime): Repro plan: run a small load test hitting structured_output endpoint with concurrency 8 and verify JSON. Temp mitigation: set header X-Redwood-Isolate-KV: true or disable continuous batching for Acme tenant.

Jordan (Support): Can you provide curl we can give to customer to flip the header?

Priya (eng-runtime): Sure:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
 -H "X-Redwood-Isolate-KV: true" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}],"structured_output":true}'
```

Tom (eng-ml): For a hotfix I'll add cloning of KV handle in the batcher when structured_output=true OR when isolation header present. Unit tests: simulate interleaved reqs and assert outputs not concatenated.

Priya (eng-runtime): I'll build a canary patch to disable reuse of kv_handle for non-streaming batches and push to staging. If green, deploy to hosted and add a routing rule to send Acme traffic to non-batched path.

Jordan (Support): I'll ask Acme to try the header and report back. Also prep for SLA credit if they saw production impact.

Lina (oncall): Owners: Priya (patch), Tom (tests), Jordan (customer comms). ETA: hotfix N+1 day for canary, full deploy N+2 days. If customer needs immediate relief, we can enable tenant isolation now.

Everyone: reactions: :+1: :eyes:
